dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r02.d01: page_break_by member group (Page Break checkbox) is enabled_when group_by != none; while group_by = none it is disabled and page_break_by is forced to its disabled_value none, so a stale tick never reaches the PDF renderer.

dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r03.d01: With report_by = code (default): report_format is forced to summary (forced_when report_by != provider; option detail enabled_when report_by == provider); procedure_codes is visible (visible_when report_by != provider); group_by offers none / provider / carrier; include_ucr is enabled (enabled_when not (report_by == provider and report_format == detail)).
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r03.d02: include_z_codes and compare_fee_schedule_id are enabled_when include_ucr == true (disabled_value false / null); compare_fee_schedule_id is required_when include_ucr == true (inferred, shared rule of 04).
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r03.d03: The page_break_by member group checkbox carries the label 'Page Break by Provider' when group_by == provider (label_when, shared rule of 04); the value is page_break_by = group. Its default stays unticked: the sample shows it ticked, but nothing documents an automatic tick on this report.
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r03.d04: provider_ids is visible_when report_by == provider or group_by == provider (shared rule of 04); otherwise it is hidden and forced to all.
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r03.d05: report_format option detail is enabled_when report_by == provider; for code, category and carrier report_format is forced to summary. Category and Carrier states were never captured: the rule follows the vendor text (Detail only for Provider) and is to be confirmed on the live tool.
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r03.d06: group_by is enabled_when report_by != provider; under report_by = provider it is disabled and forced to none (the legacy greys only the Provider and Carrier options, which leaves None as the only choice - same effect).
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r03.d07: procedure_codes is visible_when report_by != provider (hidden and forced to all for provider); provider_ids becomes visible through its visible_when report_by == provider.
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r03.d08: sort_by (transaction_date / patient_last_name) is visible_when report_by == provider and report_format == detail (inferred, shared rule of 04: the state was seen only with both set); hidden otherwise, value forced to its disabled_value.
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r03.d09: include_ucr is enabled_when not (report_by == provider and report_format == detail): greyed (disabled_value false) only in the observed Provider + Detail state; Provider + Summary keeps it, as the 2016 Production by Provider Summary sample prints the compare-fee column. include_z_codes and compare_fee_schedule_id follow through include_ucr == true. Which of the two drives the greying is to be confirmed on the live tool.

dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r05.d01: check_type is enabled_when ['in', 'payment_types', ['check']] holds (the list contains check); otherwise disabled with disabled_value both.
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r05.d02: batch_check_grouping is enabled_when group_batch_checks == true (disabled_value batch_id); group_batch_checks itself is enabled_when the payment_types list contains check (inferred).
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r05.d03: office_scope: mode office_group switches the picker to lookup:office_groups and writes office_group_id with default all; mode office uses lookup:offices and office_ids with default working_office. Exactly one value key is sent.
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r05.d04: Hub feature (07): a report opened from a saved view or favorite shows 'Update favorite' instead of 'Add to favorites'; the action updates that report_saved_views row (new definition_version stamped).

dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r08.d01: date_basis option appointment_date is enabled_when report_type != detail and appointments_to_include is enabled_when report_type != detail (disabled_value only_missing_progress_notes); under report_type = detail a stored appointment_date basis falls back to service_date. Whether Unsigned also unlocks them (or only Missing) is to be confirmed on the live tool.

dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r10.d01: page_break_by member group is enabled_when group_by == provider and default_when group_by == provider sets it to group (shared rule of 04: ticked automatically). The user may untick it; whether the legacy locks it is to be confirmed.
dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r10.d02: office_scope: mode office_group switches the picker to lookup:office_groups and writes office_group_id with default all; mode office uses lookup:offices and office_ids with default working_office.

dynamic_rules.daily_reports.r12.d01: code_scope (scoped_selection): code_scope_mode = code reads lookup:procedure_codes, code_scope_mode = category reads lookup:procedure_categories for code_scope_selection. Changing the mode resets code_scope_selection to all (design decision; legacy reset behaviour not documented - confirm in RPT-DAILY-80); none stays allowed in both modes.
